MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  Adjourned Meeting/Joint Housing Element Kick-Off Workshop
  City Council and Planning and Transportation Commission

  March 31, 2021

Due to COVID-19 and the “Stay at Home” Order for the State of California and the Social
Distance Guidelines issued by Federal, State, and Local Authorities this Council Meeting was
conducted via Video Teleconferencing for all Council and Staff with the exception of the City
Attorney and City Clerk who were present in the Council Chamber. All public comments that
were emailed to the City Clerk were read during the meeting.

A Regular Meeting of the City Council, and the Planning and Transportation Commission of the
City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor Kelley at 6:04 p.m., on March 31,
2021, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted by
5:00 p.m. on March 25, 2021, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. A copy was also posted at
the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive and Norman P. Murray
Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

Teleconferenced:  Council Member Goodell (arrived at 6:07 p.m.)
  Council Member Raths
  Council Member Sachs
  Mayor Pro Tem Bucknum
  Mayor Kelley

  Commissioner Breton
  Commissioner Molinari (arrived at 6:10 p.m.)
  Commissioner Quinio
  Vice Chairman Blum
  Chairman Ruesch

Absent:  None

Staff  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
Teleconferenced:  Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services

Staff Present:  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk
  Renata Winter, Assistant City Clerk

INVOCATION: Mayor Kelley

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chairman Ruesch

City Council Minutes  1  March 31, 2021
 PUBLIC COMMENTS

NEW BUSINESS

1.  General Plan Housing Element Update (6th cycle) for the period 2021-2029

  Director of Community Development Elaine Lister gave the staff report.

  Housing Element Consultant John Douglas gave a power point presentation on the 2021
  Housing Element Update.

  The following written comments were received in favor of affordable housing in the City of
  Mission Viejo: Barbara Schulman, Rona Henry, Linda, M.V.; Ryan Lenney, M.V.; Karen
  Tagawa, M.V.; Anna Riviere, M.V.; John Achee, M.V.; Cesar Covarrubias (The Kennedy
  Commission); June Maguire, M.V.; Mary Carlson, M.V.; Aaron Hand, M.V.; Sally Simmons,
  M.V.; Ann Owens, Lake Forest; Marilyn Schroeder, M.V.; JoAnne Kondori, M.V.; Alexandra
  Berk, M.V.; Keith Tuominen, M.V.; Donna Farris, M.V.; Frances Morgan, M.V.; Lynn
  Tommie Kozlov, M.V.; Judy Fike, M.V.; Barbara Daly; Dick and Beth McConaughy, M.V.;
  Cathy Palmer, M.V.; and Bharti Patel, M.V.

  City Council Members and Planning Commissioners asked questions of staff and the
  consultant.

  The report was received by the City Council and Planning and Transportation Commission

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 7:58 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council and the Planning
and Transportation Commission at this session, Mayor Kelley adjourned the Planning and
Transportation Commission.to Monday April 12, 2021 at 6:30 p.m. and adjourned the City Council
to Tuesday April 13, 2021 at 5:00 p.m.

______________________________________
Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of April 13, 2021

City Council Minutes  2  March 31, 2021
